identity.name: Sheet Personalizer
identity.vibe: Professional, High-Precision, Growth-Oriented, Dark Mode Control Room
principles: Fusion: Spreadsheet Utility x Cyberpunk Aesthetics
Content: Data is the hero; UI is the frame
Contrast: Deep blacks vs. Glowing Emeralds

containers.glass_panel: bg-zinc-900/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-2xl

buttons.primary: h-10 px-6 rounded-md bg-emerald-500 text-black font-medium hover:bg-emerald-400 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_-5px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_-5px_rgba(16,185,129,0.7)]
buttons.secondary: h-10 px-6 rounded-md bg-zinc-900 text-white border border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all duration-200
buttons.ghost: h-10 px-4 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

inputs.default: h-10 bg-zinc-950/50 border-zinc-800 focus:border-emerald-500/50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 rounded-md text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 transition-all

cards.dashboard: bg-zinc-900/20 border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

wizard.step_active: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 text-black flex items-center justify-center font-bold shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]
wizard.step_inactive: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 flex items-center justify-center

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: npm install lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge @radix-ui/react-slot
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (emerald-500 as primary) and fonts (Outfit/Inter).
3. GLOBAL CSS: Update index.css with the HSL values for the dark theme variables provided in the 'colors' section.
4. LAYOUT STRATEGY: Use the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard. Dense data, high contrast.
5. WIZARD LOGIC: Implement the 5-step wizard using a state machine approach. Keep the UI focused - one step at a time.
6. COLUMN MAPPING: Use a clean two-column layout. Left: Source (Sheet Headers), Right: Target (App Fields). Use Select/Dropdown components.
7. FEEDBACK: Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications. Success = Emerald, Error = Red.
8. ANIMATION: Add subtle entrance animations (fade-in-up) to the wizard steps and dashboard cards using framer-motion.
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text unless specifically asked.
DO NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (brightness-110 or bg-opacity change).
Use 'data-testid' on all buttons and inputs.
Dark mode is default and only mode. Do not implement light mode toggle.
